title: CONTINUED CONSIDERATION OF MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - McOSKER) relative to evaluating potential litigation options related to the Los Angeles Continuum of Care…
text:
[Council File 26-1485]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
CONTINUED CONSIDERATION OF MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - McOSKER) relative to evaluating potential litigation options related to the Los Angeles Continuum of Care bidding process and other related matters concerning the regional homelessness response system.
Recommendations for Council action:
REQUEST the City Attorney to report on potential litigation options related to the Los Angeles Continuum of Care bidding process and other related matters concerning the regional homelessness response system.
INSTRUCT the City Administrative Officer, Chief Legislative Analyst, and Los Angeles Housing Department to report on negotiations with the County to ensure meaningful City leadership and fair share of resources in the implementation of the homelessness response system and actions to initiate formation of a City-only Continuum of Care.
[The City Council may recess to Closed Session pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(4) to confer with its legal counsel relative to the possible initiation of litigation (One potential case relative to the City's applications to the Continuum of Care Board to be the Homeless Management Information System lead and Coordinated Entry System manager.).]

outcome.text: Council adopted item as amended, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 23, 2026); Council action final

summary: Council adopted, subject to reconsideration, a motion asking the City Attorney to report on possible litigation over the regional Continuum of Care bidding process, and asking for reports on County negotiations toward a City-only Continuum of Care.

details.action: request for City Attorney report on litigation options
